Contents · Stata index · R index · 中文

Start with the expanded examples. Open further examples for options and alternative R approaches.

about

Inspect R version and platform information

Stata 

about

R utils 

utils::sessionInfo()

Reports R session metadata; Stata license and serial information have no R counterpart.

Stata reference · R reference

adopath

Inspect the package library search path

Stata 

adopath

R base 

.libPaths()

R package libraries replace ado search directories; this only reads the current path.

Stata reference · R reference

args

Receive two positional arguments in a function

Stata 

program define addtwo
args a b
display `a'+`b'
end

R base 

addtwo <- function(a,b) a+b

R function arguments replace positional Stata macros; this is a fixed program example.

Stata reference · R reference

continue

Skip the rest of one loop iteration

Stata 

forvalues i=1/4 {
    if `i'==2 continue
    display `i'
}

R base 

out <- integer(); for (i in 1:4) { if(i==2) next; out <- c(out,i) }

Fixed workflow example; adapt the object and column names together.

Stata reference · R reference

Exit a loop early

Stata 

forvalues i=1/4 {
    if `i'==3 continue, break
    display `i'
}

R base 

out <- integer(); for (i in 1:4) { if(i==3) break; out <- c(out,i) }

Fixed workflow example; adapt the object and column names together.

Stata reference · R reference

creturn

Inspect R version, platform, paths and numeric limits

Stata 

creturn list

R base 

list(version=R.version.string,platform=R.version$platform,working_directory=getwd(),machine=.Machine)

Returns R's own settings and constants, not Stata's c-class values.

Stata reference · R reference

dataex

Create reproducible R code for a small data example

Stata 

dataex id x in 1/3

R base 

example <- data[1:3,c('id','x')]; text <- utils::capture.output(dput(example))

dput emits R reconstruction code, not Stata input code or forum markup. Share only data already approved for disclosure.

Stata reference · R reference

exit

Return early from a function

Stata 

program define positive
args x
if `x'<=0 exit
display `x'
end

R base 

positive <- function(x) { if(x<=0) return(invisible(NULL)); x }

Function-level return only; quitting the R process would terminate the user's session.

Stata reference · R reference

include

Execute helper code in the current evaluation environment

Stata 

include helper.do

R base 

sys.source(path,envir=environment())

Only sources the controlled temporary R helper here; R syntax replaces the Stata do-file.

Stata reference · R reference

mark

Create an inclusion marker from a condition

Stata 

mark touse if g == 2

R base 

data$touse <- as.integer(!is.na(data$g) & data$g==2)

Stata reference · R reference

markout

Clear an inclusion marker when variables are incomplete

Stata 

markout touse x y

R base 

data$touse <- as.integer(data$touse==1 & stats::complete.cases(data[c('x','y')]))

Stata reference · R reference

matname

Name matrix columns

Stata 

matname X first second, columns(1..2)

R base 

colnames(X)[1:2] <- c("first", "second")

Renames columns 1 and 2 without changing names of any later columns.

Stata reference · R reference

mkmat

Create a matrix from selected numeric variables

Stata 

mkmat x y, matrix(X)

R base 

X <- as.matrix(data[c('x','y')])

Differs from Stata X is the fixed matrix object name; R row names need not match Stata r1, r2 labels.

Stata reference · R reference

Create a matrix after listwise missing exclusion

Stata 

mkmat x y, matrix(X) nomissing

R base 

X <- as.matrix(data[stats::complete.cases(data[c('x','y')]),c('x','y')])

Stata reference · R reference

numlist

Expand a numeric list with a fixed step

Stata 

numlist "1(2)9"

R base 

values <- seq(1,9,by=2)

Constructs this list directly; it does not parse arbitrary Stata numlist strings.

Stata reference · R reference

Expand a decreasing consecutive numeric list

Stata 

numlist "5/1"

R base 

values <- seq(5,1,by=-1)

Direct R sequence workflow for the displayed Stata list.

Stata reference · R reference

query

Inspect current R output settings

Stata 

query output

R base 

options()[c('width','digits','scipen')]

Read-only R settings query; these are R-specific options rather than Stata parameter names.

Stata reference · R reference

sleep

Pause execution using milliseconds converted to seconds

Stata 

sleep 1

R base 

Sys.sleep(0.001)

R Sys.sleep takes seconds; no machine-speed timing assertion is made.

Stata reference · R reference

sysdir

Inspect R installation and temporary directories

Stata 

sysdir list

R base 

list(home=R.home(),library=R.home('library'),temporary=tempdir())

Shows R directories; Stata BASE/PLUS/PERSONAL directories have no one-to-one mapping.

Stata reference · R reference

tempfile

Reserve a unique temporary path

Stata 

tempfile cache

R base 

path <- tempfile(fileext='.rds')

Differs from Stata tempfile() reserves a name without creating a file; R does not guarantee Stata-style cleanup of each named file when a function exits.

Stata reference · R reference

tokenize

Split simple whitespace-separated tokens

Stata 

tokenize alpha beta gamma

R base 

tokens <- strsplit('alpha beta gamma',' +')[[1]]

Differs from Stata R returns a character vector instead of positional local macros; quoted-token parsing differs.

Stata reference · R reference

unab

Expand a column-name prefix wildcard

Stata 

unab vars : x*

R base 

vars <- grep('^x',names(data),value=TRUE)

Handles the displayed simple prefix wildcard; this is not a complete Stata varlist parser.

Stata reference · R reference

viewsource

Inspect the body of a named R function

Stata 

viewsource mean.ado

R base 

body(base::mean.default)

Reads an R function body rather than opening a Stata ado source editor.
